scope.providerSelection: When both verified injected providers exist, YNX and MetaMask remain explicit choices; no silent provider selection.
scope.connectedDapps: The Companion stores only an exact current HTTPS-origin, selected provider, 0x1917, and provider-returned account record. It is not a wallet-wide permission inventory.
scope.disconnect: Disconnect clears only the Companion local record and remembered session. It does not call wallet_revokePermissions and does not claim wallet permission revocation.
scope.accountSwitch: accountsChanged accepts an exact replacement account only while the current chain remains 0x1917; empty accounts, a disconnect, or a chain change invalidate the local record.
